title: Panel: Cross Border Capital in Critical Minerals
gist: Member-only video page for a 34-minute Benchmark Week 2026 panel on cross-border capital in critical minerals, with Jefferies, Standard Chartered, NEO Capital and Benchmark's Adam Panayi. It covered cross-border capital, multilateral offtake agreements and international ESG standards for critical mineral supply chains. No transcript or conclusions are given.

themes.theme: Financing critical mineral supply chains across borders

insights.claim: A Benchmark Week 2026 panel had investors, miners, processors and banks discuss cross-border capital, multilateral offtake agreements and international ESG standards for critical mineral supply chains.
insights.speaker: Michael Willoughby, Global Co-Head of Metals & Mining, Jefferies; Ling Lu, Managing Director, Metals and Mining, Standar
insights.so_what: Multilateral offtakes and shared ESG standards are being discussed as ways to fund non-Chinese critical mineral supply.
insights.quote: Investors, miners, processors and banks discuss cross-border capital, multilateral offtake agreements and international ESG standards for critical mineral supply chains.

insights.claim: The cross-border capital panel included Michael Willoughby (Jefferies), Ling Lu (Standard Chartered), Anthony Tse (NEO Capital) and Adam Panayi (Benchmark Mineral Intelligence). The page is member-only and states no deal terms or views.
insights.speaker: Michael Willoughby, Global Co-Head of Metals & Mining, Jefferies; Ling Lu, Managing Director, Metals and Mining, Standar
insights.so_what: Investment banks and specialist funds are publicly engaging on critical-minerals financing, but their positions are not disclosed here.

insights.claim: A Do-Fluoride keynote at Benchmark Week 2026 addressed market and cost pressures in battery electrolyte salts, the capacity outlook, upstream fluorine security, and scaling materials for fast-charging and energy storage.
insights.speaker: Michael Willoughby, Global Co-Head of Metals & Mining, Jefferies; Ling Lu, Managing Director, Metals and Mining, Standar
insights.so_what: Fluorine supply security is flagged as an upstream bottleneck for electrolyte salts, a less-watched part of the battery chain.
insights.quote: Do-Fluoride on market and cost pressures in battery electrolyte salts, capacity outlook, upstream fluorine security and scaling materials for fast-charging and energy storage.

insights.claim: Benchmark's cathode market update at Benchmark Week 2026 covered cathode and precursor capacity growth across Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe, and regional pricing arbitrage between them.
insights.speaker: Michael Willoughby, Global Co-Head of Metals & Mining, Jefferies; Ling Lu, Managing Director, Metals and Mining, Standar
insights.so_what: Cathode capacity is spreading beyond China to Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe, and regional price gaps create arbitrage that affects producer margins.
insights.quote: Cathode and precursor capacity growth across Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe, regional pricing arbitrage, and which producers are leading global expansion.
